gen-dafont-good-times-gf-lexend-exa: Lexend Exa reads wide and open, with stubby ascenders tucked beside a big x-height and curves that never pinch. Lexend Exa carries a long page without fuss, each line steady underneath the broad Good Times heading.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-lexend-giga: Good Times is a commanding geometric display face, its thin strokes about half the weight of its thick ones. Lexend Giga just draws each letter in one constant line, loosely tracked, and keeps going.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-lexend-mega: Approachable is the first word for Lexend Mega, a plain sans with a body height nearly matching its capitals and no brush-like pressure anywhere. And over a full page it keeps moving smoothly, while Good Times above it stays a little glassy and tapered.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-lexend-peta: Professional but friendly, Lexend Peta has wide-mouthed c shapes and curves that never thin out, sitting under Good Times. And through a long page its sturdy x-height keeps lines easy to follow, with no soft swell to distract.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-lexend-tera: Good Times has a faint but real thick-thin shift in its commanding geometric letters, like glass rods catching light. Lexend Tera, drawn like a plotter pen, spaces its open curves out like stepping stones, so a long page moves slowly and cleanly.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-lexend-zetta: Chunky small letters, thick as bundled cable, give Good Times its commanding weight over the page. And Lexend Zetta follows in ribbon-cut strokes and wide tracking, so a long stretch of text feels approachable and unhurried.
gen-dafont-good-times-gf-montserrat-alte: Wide, bold geometry with a bundled-cable chunkiness is what Good Times brings, and Montserrat Alternates answers in ruler-straight lines with a very open c. Over many lines the sans stays crisp and compact.
gen-dafont-magnum-poppins: Magnum's e nearly closes into a loop, giving it a dense, commanding punch. Poppins is the one that opens up, with loose curves and a tall sturdy body, while Magnum does the shouting.
gen-dafont-mexcellent-poppins: Pinched, retro and chunky, Mexcellent has curves squeezed shut like a wire loop and a tall midzone. Poppins sits beneath it with loose, open curves, so the nostalgia stays up top.
gen-dafont-molot-poppins: Heavy and authoritative, Molot rises close to cap height. Poppins loosens everything beneath it, with open curves and a tall sturdy body that give Molot's narrow c openings room to stand out.
